title: ruppia maritima var. curvicarpa
intro: Ruppia maritima var. curvicarpa, commonly known as the sea plant or marine ruppia, is a type of aquatic plant belonging to the family Potamogetonaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ruppia maritima var. curvicarpa include reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and exhibiting antibacterial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
